title: Senior Field Marketing Manager, Events
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

As the Senior Field Marketing Manager, Events, you will own the strategy and execution of Harness' North America regional field marketing and events portfolio, designing integrated marketing programs that accelerate pipeline, strengthen customer relationships, and elevate the Harness brand across enterprise technology audiences.

This is a strategic, cross-functional role for someone who thinks beyond event logistics. You'll develop investment strategies, identify growth opportunities, and partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Executive Leadership to create experiences that deliver measurable business impact

About the role

  • Own the strategy, planning, and execution of Harness' North America regional field marketing event portfolio, aligning investments with revenue goals, product launches, and regional go-to-market priorities.
  • Build scalable event playbooks and operational frameworks that support multiple regions, product lines, and future organizational growth.
  • Evaluate sponsorship opportunities and recommend event investments based on audience fit, pipeline potential, executive engagement, and business impact.
  • Develop engagement strategies before, during, and after events to maximize interactions with high-value prospects and customers.
  • Manage end-to-end event execution, including budget management, vendors, staffing, creative, production, logistics, and onsite operations, while ensuring a consistent and differentiated Harness brand experience.
  • Track KPIs across engagement, pipeline, revenue influence, and ROI, using performance data and attendee insights to optimize event investments.
  • Develop post-event recommendations that influence future investments, optimize performance, and improve overall event strategy

About you

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS field marketing, strategic events, or integrated marketing, with a strong focus supporting enterprise sales organizations.
  • Strategy: Proven success developing and executing integrated field marketing and event strategies that drive measurable pipeline, revenue, executive engagement, and brand awareness.
  • Cross Functional Engagement: Experience developing strong relationships with Sales counterparts and partnering cross-functionally with Demand Generation and Product Marketing to execute go-to-market initiatives.
  • Project Management: Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex, high-impact programs simultaneously.
  • Analytics: Strong experience using performance metrics and insights to optimize marketing investments, measure ROI, and inform strategic decisions.
  • Event Management: Experience managing marketing budgets, agency relationships, vendors, and event production from planning through execution.
  • Communication: Outstanding presentation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with executives, customers, and external partners.
  • Travel + Pace: Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities and a bias toward action. Ability and willingness to travel 25-30% of the time for on-site event management.

Work Location

  • Remote or Hybrid within the West Coast of the U.S

What you will have at Harness

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
  • Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
  • Monthly internet reimbursement

Pay transparency

$125,000—$140,000 USD

Harness in the news:

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Marketing Campaign Manager
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Marketing Campaign Manager to lead the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple business units within our Education Division. This role will act as the key liaison between each business unit and our external marketing agency to drive pipeline growth across the division’s portfolio of products and services.

Location: This role is open to candidates based in the Eastern U.S. time zone as a fully remote opportunity, with a preference for candidates based in or near Leeds, UK, where the role can be offered in a hybrid/remote capacity.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and lead comprehensive, multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned to business unit goals.
  • Collaborate with business unit stakeholders to understand target audiences, value propositions, and key business priorities to inform marketing campaign strategy and messaging.

Execution & Project Management

  • Manage end-to-end campaign execution, partnering with business unit functional teams and our external marketing agency.
  • Own campaign timelines, deliverables, and budgets, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.

Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance using marketing analytics tools and dashboards.
  • Continuously test, optimize, and iterate based on data-driven insights to improve conversion rates and pipeline contribution.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner closely with sales to ensure campaign alignment, support enablement, and accelerate opportunities.
  • Communicate campaign plans, performance, and insights to key stakeholders across marketing and business leadership.

Competencies

  • Strategic Execution: Able to translate business objectives into measurable marketing campaigns. Balances creative concepts with analytical rigor to ensure campaigns ladder up to pipeline, revenue, and brand goals. Demonstrates a strong understanding of audience segmentation and funnel dynamics.
  • Analytical Decision-Making: Comfortable interpreting campaign data to identify patterns, draw insights, and recommend next steps. Skilled at using experimentation frameworks (A/B, multivariate, incrementality) to validate hypotheses and continuously improve performance.
  • Operational Excellence: Drives campaigns from ideation through post-mortem with exceptional organization and attention to detail. Anticipates dependencies across channels, timelines, and stakeholders; maintains clear documentation and repeatable processes for scale.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Communicates campaign goals, insights, and results clearly across marketing, sales, product, and leadership teams. Skilled in vendor and stakeholder management, ensuring alignment on deliverables, expectations, and optimization decisions.
  • Agility and Growth Mindset: Thrives in dynamic environments. Rapidly adapts to performance trends, feedback, or market changes while maintaining focus on long-term objectives. Demonstrates curiosity and continuous learning in new platforms, tools, and testing methods.
  • Creative and Brand Stewardship: Shows strong creative judgment and an eye for brand consistency across channels. Partners effectively with content and design teams to ensure messaging and visuals drive engagement while staying true to the company’s identity.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 2+ years in campaign management.
  • Experience managing campaigns across multiple business units or products within a division.
  • Proven success driving integrated campaigns that deliver measurable business outcomes (pipeline, revenue)
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot (or Marketo/Eloqua), Google Analytics, and project management tools.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with segmentation, personalization, and campaign automation best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Vertical B2B SaaS experience in education or edtech

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

EEOC & ADA Statement:

Cordance and its companies provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, creed, sex, nationality, ancestry, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Cordance and its companies comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources.

This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Final candidate must be able to pass a background check.

To view applicant notices required under federal and state law, please visit: https://cordance.co/applicant-notices/

title: B2B Event Marketing Manager (6-Month Contract)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's commercial event calendar, spanning premier industry tradeshows like Cannes Lions, Expo West, and Shoptalk Europe alongside owned executive programs and bespoke cultural hospitality experiences, needs dedicated, hands-on ownership for the next six months. Without this role, event logistics, vendor relationships, and cross-functional coordination across Sales, Corp Comms, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative go unmanaged at a critical point in our B2B growth. This contract role exists to ensure every Instacart presence at a major industry event is executed with precision, on budget, and with measurable impact. By the end of the engagement, Instacart's reputation as a sophisticated event marketer in the eCommerce, AdTech, and CPG space will be meaningfully advanced.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Instacart's B2B event calendar is executed flawlessly across premier tradeshows (Cannes Lions, Expo West, Shoptalk Europe), executive programs, and bespoke hospitality experiences, with every event delivered on time and within budget.
  • Event creative assets are produced in close partnership with marketing, creative, and sales teams, ensuring consistent brand representation across all touchpoints.
  • Project plans, timelines, and budgets are built and maintained per event, giving stakeholders across Sales, Corp Comms, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative clear visibility and alignment throughout.
  • A reporting and measurement framework is in place that captures event performance and informs future investment decisions.
  • Vendor and contract relationships are managed efficiently, with invoicing and negotiations handled smoothly to keep event operations running without friction.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5 to 10 years of B2B event marketing experience
  • Hands-on Cannes Lions experience required
  • Proven track record managing high-profile tradeshows and industry events
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with contract negotiation and vendor invoicing
  • Comfortable with administrative duties and operational support
  • Ability to travel 2 to 4 times during the contract period

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with Cvent, Salesforce, Google Sheets, or Excel
  • Experience with events in the eCommerce, AdTech, and/or CPG marketing industries
  • Experience managing large-scale events (100 to 600+ attendees)

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CA, NY, CT, NJ

$142,000—$150,000 USD

WA

$136,000—$143,500 USD

OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI

$131,000—$138,000 USD

All other states

$119,000—$125,500 USD

By the end of the engagement, Instacart's reputation as a sophisticated event marketer in the eCommerce, AdTech, and CPG space will be meaningfully advanced.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Instacart's B2B event calendar is executed flawlessly across premier tradeshows (Cannes Lions, Expo West, Shoptalk Europe), executive programs, and bespoke hospitality experiences, with every event delivered on time and within budget.
  • Event creative assets are produced in close partnership with marketing, creative, and sales teams, ensuring consistent brand representation across all touchpoints.
  • Project plans, timelines, and budgets are built and maintained per event, giving stakeholders across Sales, Corp Comms, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative clear visibility and alignment throughout.
  • A reporting and measurement framework is in place that captures event performance and informs future investment decisions.
  • Vendor and contract relationships are managed efficiently, with invoicing and negotiations handled smoothly to keep event operations running without friction.
